AI video regeneration (experimental) · not sentence-level translation or lip sync

This is AI video regeneration, not sentence-level translation or lip sync; no real translation channel is connected

The upstream video endpoint has no source/target language or lip-sync parameters: the language you pick below is only written into the prompt. It cannot guarantee a language swap, subtitles or lip alignment. Treat every result as an unverified draft and have a human confirm it before use.

Based on the r27 protocol investigation (commit 1ef24fba): the sub2api MiniMax video endpoint exposes no translation fields.
